name: The Ren'ai Simulation ~Watashi ni Oma-café~
original_name: THE 恋愛シミュレーション ～私におまカフェ～
source:
Main character follows the will of deceased parents and becomes a manager in a coffee shop in his free from study time. He becomes famous in town as the only high school manager. Can he have both work and love with so many pretty waitresses around?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公遵照已故父母的遗愿，在课余时间担任一家咖啡店的店长。作为全镇唯一的高中生店长，他很快声名远播。身边有这么多漂亮女服务员，他能否兼顾工作与恋爱？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
